{{nihongo|'''Inakami Shrine'''|伊那上神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

=== Overview ===
It is enshrined southeast of central Matsuzaki, on the east side just before {{ill|Japan National Route 136|af|Japan Nasionale Roete 136|ja|国道136号|zh_min_nan|Ji̍t-pún Kok-tō 136-hō|qid=Q11421406}} reaches the Naka River.

Its founding is unknown, but originally it was a shrine of {{ill|Mishima–Ōyamazumi cult|ja|三島・大山祇信仰|qid=Q127948103}} said to have been invited either from {{ill|Ōyamazumi Shrine|abstract|Q703904|fr|Ōyamazumi-jinja|ja|大山祇神社|ru|Оямадзуми-дзиндзя|zh|大山祇神社|qid=Q703904}} in {{ill|Iyo Province|cs|Provincie Ijo|de|Provinz Iyo|es|Provincia de Iyo|fa|ولایت ایو|fi|Iyon === Enshrined deity ===
* {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Tsumiha-yae Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto}}

=== Cultural properties ===
* Pine-eating cranes mirror - prefectural designated tangible cultural property.
* Seated male deity statue - town designated tangible cultural property.

The Kikkōmatsu (over 350 years old), formerly a town-designated natural monument, died in March {{ill|1993|Q2065|qid=Q2065}} (Heisei 5)<ref name="town"/>.
